title: P0 gap: ODN-5 fail-fast validation of the new packet_types/demand loaders has zero error-path tests
detail: The two dozen new fail-fast rules (bad JSON, unknown shape/class_id/role/selection, latency/loss/bandwidth/lane/era bounds, set-piece multiplier/duration, required email/streaming) are exercised only happy-path via harness data loads. No malformed-input test exists anywhere; the gap already hides one live silent-default (separate finding).
recommended_fix: Add table-driven negative tests feeding malformed packet_types.json/demand.json byte strings to catalogs_load — one per fail-fast rule — asserting the named Catalog_Error file/field; keep the happy-path harness load.

title: color_rgba element guard checks outer `ok` (always true) instead of `okc` — malformed element silently becomes 0
detail: After the root-object check, `ok` is always true, so `!ok` never fires: a non-integer color_rgba element yields n=0 and is stored as u8(0) — an ODN-5 silent default. Verified empirically (scratch copy, worktree untouched): string element accepted, empty error, color [0,98,112,255].
recommended_fix: Change `!ok` to `!okc` in the guard; add a negative test with a non-integer color_rgba element asserting the "color_rgba must be 4 ints in 0..255" Catalog_Error.

title: weighted_pick_excluding untested: dst weighting pinned only for all-equal weights; all-excluded skip path never exercised
detail: The §3.3 flow-level pin uses demand_weight=1 on every sink, so a weights-ignoring dst pick would still pass it; only the weighted_pick primitive gets a non-uniform ([1,2,3]) distribution test. weighted_pick_excluding's weighting, and its all-excluded → ok=false skip (single-sink topology silently spawns nothing), are uncovered.
recommended_fix: Unit-test weighted_pick_excluding: non-uniform-weight distribution pin, excluded slot never picked across draws, all-positive-weight-excluded returns ok=false; add a single-sink flow_step test asserting deterministic skip.

title: Director boundary branches untested: era-beyond-catalog empty plan; vol<=0 spec skip
detail: The era==0 empty-plan branch is pinned (test_era0_legacy_no_rng_draws), but the era>len(eras) empty-plan branch and the vol<=0 spec-skip (volume 0 passes load validation since only `< 0` rejects) have no boundary tests. P3 gaps; both branches are deterministic no-ops by inspection.
recommended_fix: Add a test stepping an era beyond the catalog asserting zero director spawns + unchanged rng, and a zero-volume era entry asserting no spawns for that spec.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0 5/6 (~83%, gate needs 100%): spawn determinism [E10], §3.3 dst pin (uniform case), surge window boundaries, era-0 no-rng-draw, era-3 QoS golden replay all covered and green at 37f5581 (`odin test` 59/59, harness 8/8 incl. qos replay, drift-check 47/47); catalog fail-fast [ODN-5] error paths uncovered. P1 ~60-70% (weighted-dst weighting, skip paths). Overall ~75-80%.
recommended_fix: Land the malformed-catalog negative-test suite (P0 → 100%) plus weighted_pick_excluding unit pins and the boundary tests (P1 ≥ 90%); the gate then passes.
